This expression removes any extra spaces, punctuation, and special characters from the hospital names. It then splits the cleaned name into words and checks if the first word is a type of ownership (e.g., voluntary non-profit). If it is, it returns the hospital name with only the ownership and hospital type. If not, it simply returns the cleaned hospital name. This makes the data more concise and easier to identify hospitals based on ownership type and hospital type.
